import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    res = True
    while m > 0:
        r = m % w
        if r == 0 or r == 1:
            m //= w
        else:
            if r == w - 1:
                m += 1
            else:
                res = False
                break
    print("YES" if res else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
